first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: First-person figure; only the hands wearing purple patterned gloves and warm-brown forearms are visible, with a wide black band on the right wrist.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A light-gold handgun operated by Person A, with an elongated slide; in the final frame, most of the grip is occluded by both hands.

entities.name: white locker group beside the doorway
entities.identification: The off-white locker group beside the doorway, with thick black graffiti, vertical locker-door edges, and some ventilation slots visible.

entities.name: wide doorway with a white frame
entities.identification: The opening beside the lockers that leads to the gray corridor, with a thick, light-colored vertical frame visible on the near side.

entities.name: rear wall with skull graffiti
entities.identification: The light-gray wall at the far end of the corridor, with a dark skull outline and purple rounded letter-shaped graffiti on it.

entities.name: light-colored locker-room wall
entities.identification: The light-beige wall-column area between the lockers and the corridor opening, with vertical surfaces of differing brightness.

entities.name: indoor metal grid ceiling
entities.identification: The ceiling above the corridor, composed of gray grating and thicker support beams.

entities.name: long overhead light fixture
entities.identification: The long, narrow strip-shaped light fixture emitting white light beneath the ceiling.

entities.name: gray corridor floor
entities.identification: The gray-blue corridor floor behind the doorway, with a yellow zigzag line and a dark-gray rectangular cover plate.

entities.name: vertically striped corridor side wall
entities.identification: The gray side wall behind the doorway; in clear frames, the vertical wall-panel texture, dark baseboard, and adjacent vertical pipe can be distinguished.

entities.name: green arrow sign
entities.identification: The green horizontal rectangular sign on the gray corridor wall; in frame 10, only light-colored markings inside it can be reliably distinguished.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The small dark figure exposed at the right edge of the distant inner doorway, with the head and part of the narrow body visible.
